house.description: Northern; base year formula aid provided.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; local government aid; providing base year formula aid to the city of Northern.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+BASE YEAR FORMULA AID FOR THE CITY OF NORTHERN. +]

[+For the calculation under Minnesota Statutes, section 477A.013, subdivisions 8 and 9, for aids payable in 2027, the city of Northern's aid for 2026, used in calculating aid payable in 2027, is deemed to be equal to $116.91 multiplied by Northern's 2024 population. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; local government aid; providing base year formula aid to the city of Northern.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BASE YEAR FORMULA AID FOR THE CITY OF NORTHERN.

For the calculation under Minnesota Statutes, section 477A.013, subdivisions 8 and 9, for aids payable in 2027, the city of Northern's aid for 2026, used in calculating aid payable in 2027, is deemed to be equal to $116.91 multiplied by Northern's 2024 population.
